made: node docs/proyecto/pixel/muralla-sheet-make.js, from muralla-set.html (window.MURALLA.E) and the design of La muralla (the orchestrator's p10-spec, general rules and section muralla). A new scene: no old scene, no remap.

rules.project: pp-engine.js project(x, y, z) with S 26 and this origin: sx = OX + (x - y) / R2 * S, sy = OY + ((x + y) / R2 * .5 - z * COS) * S, depth d = (x + y) / R2 * COS + z * .5 (R2 = sqrt 2, COS = sqrt 3 / 2); OX = W / 2 + originX = 120, OY = H / 2 + originY = 84. A box is the screen bounding box of its projected corners [floor(min x), floor(min y), ceil(max x) - floor(min x), ceil(max y) - floor(min y)]. screen is the projection rounded to whole pixels
rules.uv: the set is laid out square to the picture: a spot is given in (u, v, z), u across the picture (to the right), v down it (towards the camera), the parapet at v 0; plaza-base.js PZ.xy(u, v) = ((u + v) / R2, (v - u) / R2) gives the world x, y (world is that). On the picture sx = OX + u * S = 120 + 26 u, and sy = OY + (v / 2 - z * COS) * S = 84 + 13 v - 22.5 z (22.52 exactly); the picture holds u from -4.62 to 4.62
rules.spot: a spot is a world point of the feet (z 0: the walk; z 0.46: the bench's top; z 0.74: the table's top; z 1: the parapet's top) and, drawn there, a character stands with its feet (the lowest row the sprite draws, outline included) resting on the screen row sy, i.e. the sprite's bottom edge on sy, and its middle column on the column sx (rules.anchor). A small thing has a box (the spot's box): the camera, the candle, the glass, the plate, the chair, the table's five things, the guagua and the two walking músicos have their bottom middle on the spot (the box [sx - floor(w / 2), sy - h, w, h]); a lantern HANGS: its top middle on the spot (the box [sx - 5, sy, 10, 12]). scale is the frog's: 1 everywhere
rules.anchor: the column of the sprite that is on sx; its feet (its lowest drawn row, outline included) rest on row sy - 1, so its bottom edge is on sy. mkPersona (48 wide): column 24 (KIT.PX), 53 rows drawn standing for a grown-up (a 56-row canvas whose lowest row is empty); the frog mkCoqui(1) (32 x 27): column 16, drawn rows 1 to 24 (row 25 of the canvas is on sy); abuela standing mkAbuela (48 x 51): column 30; a grown-up sitting (mkPersona with sent = 1): column 24 and the lap row, the bottom of the hips: row 16 + 2 t + 3 (t 11 a grown-up: 41) on (sx, sy), the spot being the bench's top; a small thing: see spot. Nobody is drawn turned: whoever is said to have his back to us (abuela at her camera, the guests at the steps) is drawn facing us
rules.inside: whoever is inside a sentry box (dentro_roja, dentro_azul) is drawn from the HEAD down: the top of his sprite (its first drawn row) 2 px under the top of the door's box (things.puerta_roja.box, things.puerta_azul.box: the top row of the box + 2), his middle column on the spot's column, and CLIPPED to the door's box: only the pixels that fall inside it show, so his legs are cut by the box's bottom (the spot, the door's foot, is only where he would stand). His head (the top 14 rows of the sprite) is whole inside the door. The door is drawn open (a dark inside) under him. He casts no shadow. His depth is that of the plane through the spot (a row of the figure has the depth of the same row of a figure standing on the spot)
rules.cord: the lanterns' cord is a SPRITE (a decor layer, sheet.decor.cuerda), not part of the set: a 1 px line of colour [70,60,60] from u -2.5 to 2.5 at v 1, z 2.38 minus sin(pi (u - u0) / (u1 - u0)) * 0.25 (the three lanterns hang from it at CORD.at), one pixel per 1/26 u at the engine's plot rounding (sx | 0, sy | 0). It is drawn BEHIND every person and every thing, and behind every pixel the set bakes: its depth is the far depth of the sky (decor.cuerda.depth), so it never covers a head, a lantern or the guagua (it is not hidden by anything but is covered by everything)
rules.far: the guagua and the two walking músicos are far below the wall, on the road: given in picture pixels (the spot has px 1: its screen point is the one of the spec, its uv the line of sight through it at z 0, its depth that of that plane (-2.07), behind every pixel the set bakes: the sky, the sea and the land are not baked)
rules.view: one window, wide, zoom 1: the 196 x 216 window over the 240 x 216 picture, x0 = its left edge (22 centres it). Never a fraction
rules.depth: a spot's depth is the engine's d of its world point; front.plane turns it into the depth of each row of a character

front.how: no list. A character is hidden by every set pixel that is nearer the camera than the character's feet (depth test against the baked depth, with the feet's depth plus 0.3): the table hides the legs of whoever stands behind it, the sentry boxes hide what stands behind them, the parapet hides what is on the road. The guagua and the two walking músicos: rules.far.
front.plane: for the character's pixel on picture row r (r = 0 at the top): depth(r) = d + (sy - (r + .5)) * tan(30 deg) / S, where d is the spot's depth and sy its screen row; the pixel is hidden where bakedZ[r * 240 + x] > depth(r) + bias (bakedZ: window.DEPTH.z of the set page). The upright plane through the feet. A hanging lantern: the plane through its spot (the cord's own plane, v 1)
